notes.title: Refunds
notes.notes:
Dear gamers, 
It is with a heavy heart that I must announce that work on "Sanctuary VR" cannot continue an it is unlikely to be finished. I had hoped sales would be good enough in the early access period to provide enough funds to complete the project. However this has not happened sales were very low, wth this is mind I will not be able to complete work on the project.
I have contacted Valve and asked them change the game to a free download as I still want people to play the game.
It would be unfair to the small number of people who purchased the game if this happened so I asked valve to allow a refund to all purchasers.
So if you purchased the game please us the standard refund policy and it should be approved.
The game will be set to be a free download within the next few weeks.
